items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Red Elkins and Bill Thompson, a drummer. He was also a vibraphone player -- he played vibraphone with Earl Hines' band

ctx.x: Anyway, you came in February of '35 to D.C. Who was with you at that time?
Red Elkins and Bill Thompson, a drummer. He was also a vibraphone player -- he played vibraphone with Earl Hines' band, the last big band that Earl had.
